usage: The word '電腦' (din6 nou5) is a noun referring to a computer, a device used for computing and digital tasks.
'電腦' can be used in both formal and informal contexts when talking about technology.
It is typically used as the subject or object in a sentence, e.g., '我用電腦' (I use the computer).
You can combine '電腦' with verbs like 開 (hoi1 - to turn on), 用 (jung6 - to use), or 買 (maai5 - to buy).
In questions, '電腦' can appear after question words, e.g., '你有無電腦？' (Do you have a computer?).
